name: Reno
source:
Reno is a smart boy that volunteered to help in the Field Unity. He does several tasks to help soldiers and make sure everything is working. Reno is a very responsible and reliable person, but perhaps he is just too young to be in that place...

[From [url=https://twitter.com/LiryaRhys/status/1490695486768095232]Twitter[/url]]
